$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006). The `default` keywords here are exactly the constant defaults of 1.8's Level table; the reference canonicalizer reads them as its table of constant defaults (9.2 step 1).
title: Level
description: 1.8: a level of a building. Every level MUST reference a building (FS-CORE-1.3.1). It has only the members of its table (FS-CORE-1.4.1).

building.description: 1.3, 1.8: a reference to the building the level is in. Always present.

elevation.description: 1.8: the level's datum — the height of its finished floor above project zero, a length (2.1). Always present.

height.description: 1.8: floor-to-floor height, the default top of the level's walls (5.9). Always present, and MUST be greater than zero (FS-CORE-1.8.3).

floorThickness.description: 1.8, 15.1: the thickness of the floors of the level's rooms, unless a room's floor states its own; greater than zero when present (FS-CORE-1.8.4). Absent by default: not declared.

ceilingHeight.description: 1.8, 15.2: the height of the ceilings of the level's rooms above its elevation, unless a room's ceiling states its own; greater than zero when present (FS-CORE-1.8.4). Its default is derived — the level's height — so it carries no `default` here.

name.description: 1.4: a human-readable label, 1–200 characters. Absent by default.
